message:
## Vulnerability Digest

**Scan window:** 2026-09-03 05:10 IST to 2026-09-04 05:10 IST (2026-09-02 23:40 UTC to 2026-09-03 23:40 UTC)

This primary scan used only `Products.txt` and `List_of_SIA_Completed.txt`, with obvious naming variants deduplicated. `DLL_software_component.txt` was excluded. I verified 28 newly reported CVEs across five matched product families. Immediate review is recommended for the Chrome, Kibana, ntopng, and FTK matches described below.

### Finding 1: Google Chrome security update (12 CVEs)

- **Affected product:** Google Chrome before 152.0.7977.82
- **Vulnerabilities:** CVE-2026-85042 through CVE-2026-85053
- **Severity:** 10 High and 2 Medium, as rated by Google
- **Description:** The update addresses use-after-free, type-confusion, race-condition, out-of-bounds access, resource-exposure, and validation flaws in DevTools, Network, V8, Compositing, Skia, WebGL, Crash Reporting, Cache Storage, and mobile components. Several flaws may permit code execution inside or outside the browser sandbox when a user visits attacker-controlled content.
- **Why relevant:** The normalized inventory includes Google Chrome, including a pinned Chrome 105 build, which is older than the fixed release.
- **Source:** [Google Chrome Releases](https://chromereleases.googleblog.com/2026/09/stable-channel-update-for-desktop_01882797386.html)

### Finding 2: Elastic Kibana security advisory batch (7 CVEs)

- **Affected product:** Kibana 8.0.0-8.19.20 and selected Kibana 9.x releases; exact ranges vary by issue
- **Vulnerabilities and severity:** CVE-2026-82302 (High, 8.1), CVE-2026-78583 (High, 8.1), CVE-2026-82299 (Medium, 6.5), CVE-2026-82298 (Medium, 4.3), CVE-2026-78596 (Medium, 4.3), CVE-2026-78595 (Medium, 4.3), and CVE-2026-78593 (Medium, 4.3)
- **Description:** The advisories cover authorization failures in Fleet policy and agent operations, elevated Elasticsearch credentials reaching agents, cross-space metadata exposure and privileged writes, denial of service, and ingest-pipeline modification beyond a user's intended permissions. Some findings require Fleet, agent policy management, debugging, or specific integrations to be enabled.
- **Why relevant:** Kibana 8.18.1 appears in the inventory and falls within the affected 8.x range for most of this batch. The listed Kibana 7.17.0 entry is not within the published ranges for these specific advisories.
- **Fixed versions:** 8.19.21, 9.4.6, or 9.5.3, depending on the release line and advisory.
- **Sources:** [Elastic security announcements](https://discuss.elastic.co/c/announcements/security-announcements/31), including [ESA-2026-178](https://discuss.elastic.co/t/kibana-8-19-22-9-4-6-9-5-3-security-update-esa-2026-178/390164) and [ESA-2026-140](https://discuss.elastic.co/t/kibana-8-19-21-9-4-6-9-5-3-security-update-esa-2026-140/390158)

### Finding 3: MongoDB ecosystem advisory batch (7 CVEs)

- **Affected components and severity:** libmongocrypt before 1.20.2 (CVE-2026-84962, Medium); C Driver before 1.30.9 or 2.5.2 (CVE-2026-84963, CVE-2026-84964, CVE-2026-84965, Medium); C++ Driver before 4.5.2 (CVE-2026-84966, Medium); MongoDB for VS Code before 1.17.1 (CVE-2026-84967, Medium); PHP Driver before 1.21.8 or 2.5.1 (CVE-2026-84968, Medium).
- **Description:** The issues include authenticated Google Cloud KMS request forgery through crafted key identifiers, JSON-to-BSON integrity failures, an OCSP-path double free, 32-bit integer wraparound, out-of-bounds reads, and command injection through a supplied MongoDB connection target in the VS Code extension.
- **Why relevant:** MongoDB Community Server, MongoDB Shell, generic MongoDB entries, and Visual Studio Code are present in the inventory. Most issues are driver or library specific, so deployment teams should confirm whether the affected components are installed even though the server and shell versions alone do not establish exposure.
- **Sources:** [CVE-2026-84962](https://vulnerability.circl.lu/vuln/cve-2026-84962), [CVE-2026-84963](https://vulnerability.circl.lu/vuln/cve-2026-84963), [CVE-2026-84964](https://vulnerability.circl.lu/vuln/cve-2026-84964), [CVE-2026-84965](https://vulnerability.circl.lu/vuln/cve-2026-84965), [CVE-2026-84966](https://vulnerability.circl.lu/vuln/cve-2026-84966), [CVE-2026-84967](https://vulnerability.circl.lu/vuln/CVE-2026-84967), [CVE-2026-84968](https://vulnerability.circl.lu/vuln/cve-2026-84968), and [MongoDB driver release announcements](https://www.mongodb.com/community/forums/c/announcements/35)

The dedicated MongoDB sweep also checked MongoDB Server Community and Enterprise, mongod, mongos, Atlas and Atlas services, Ops Manager, Cloud Manager, Compass, mongosh, Database Tools, Kubernetes Operator, connectors, BI Connector, Charts, Realm and App Services, official integrations, and major maintained libraries. No additional credible MongoDB-related vulnerability first reported inside the scan window was verified.

### Finding 4: ntopng tag authorization failure

- **Affected product:** ntopng 6.7.0 through 6.7.260717
- **Vulnerability:** CVE-2026-84989
- **Severity:** High, CVSS 7.1
- **Description:** An authenticated non-administrator can rename or delete arbitrary administrator-owned tags through REST v2 endpoints because ownership checks are missing.
- **Why relevant:** The inventory contains ntopng 6.7.251215, which is inside the affected range.
- **Fixed version:** 6.7.260718
- **Sources:** [GitHub Security Advisory GHSA-43p9-5758-wwq8](https://github.com/ntop/ntopng/security/advisories/GHSA-43p9-5758-wwq8), [CVE record](https://vulnerability.circl.lu/vuln/cve-2026-84989)

### Finding 5: Exterro FTK Imager XXE

- **Affected product:** Exterro FTK Imager before 8.3
- **Vulnerability:** CVE-2026-82525
- **Severity:** Medium, CVSS 3.1 score 5.5
- **Description:** A crafted UFDR ZIP can abuse Report.xml/XSLT processing to read and potentially exfiltrate local files when an examiner previews the evidence package.
- **Why relevant:** The inventory includes AccessData FTK Imager 8.2.0.26 and AccessData FTK; AccessData is the prior FTK product lineage, and the pinned 8.2 build is below the fixed version.
- **Fixed version:** 8.3
- **Sources:** [VulnCheck advisory](https://www.vulncheck.com/advisories/exterro-ftk-imager-xxe-via-report-xml-xslt-processing), [Exterro FTK Imager 8.3 release](https://www.exterro.com/ftk-downloads/ftk-imager-8-3)

### Closing

Prioritize Chrome updates and review the two High-severity Kibana authorization issues. The pinned ntopng and FTK versions are explicitly within affected ranges and warrant prompt owner confirmation. For MongoDB, inventory the installed drivers, extensions, and libmongocrypt versions before deciding exposure. Older advisories merely republished during this window were excluded rather than reported as new.
